newsitem.title: USA: Nuevo ups '96 proved reserves by 197.8 MMBOE.
newsitem.headline: Nuevo ups '96 proved reserves by 197.8 MMBOE.

text.p: Nuevo Energy Co Tuesday said its 1996 proved reserve additions totaled 197.8 million barrels of oil equivalent (MMBOE), representing a greater than fivefold increase of the 36.9 MMBOE reported for 1995.
The additions in 1996 were composed of 185.0 MMBOE from acquisitions and 12.8 MMBOE from discoveries, extensions and revisions. The company also disposed of 7.6 MMBOE through property sales.
At year-end 1996, Nuevo had proved oil and natural gas reserves totaling 251.8 MMBOE, more than triple the reserves reported during the same period last year.
The year-end 1996 figure is composed of 186.1 million barrels of crude oil and natural gas liquids and 394.6 billion cubic feet of natural gas.
Barrels of oil equivalent is calculated by dividing billions of cubic feet of natural gas by 6 and adding it to million barrels of crude and natural gas liquids.
Total production of 19.1 MMBOE in 1996 more than doubled from 8.8 MMBOE in 1995. Nuevo's reserve life increased to 13 years in 1996 versus nine years in 1995.
At year-end 1996, Nuevo's reporting of discounted present values of oil and gas reserves after 10 years was $1.36 billion, a 270 percent increase from $367.7 million in 1995.

Mike Watford, Nuevo's President and Chief Executive Officer, attributed the large growth in reserves and the low reserve addition costs to the April 1996 acquisition of California oil and gas properties.

"The California acquisition not only gave us the low-cost growth that is apparent from our year-end reserve figures, but it also sets Nuevo up for future growth," said Watford. "As we continue to work these properties, our base of exploitation prospects has been growing. This solid exploitation base combined with our upside exploration potential places us in a strong position to meaningfully add to reserves and production in 1997."
